meta.one_line: The Dor Brothers sells bespoke AI film and commercial production to brands and agencies through portfolio-led inquiries and custom quotes; newsletter signup is separate, and sales figures are unverified.

evidence.note: 첫 페이지. 헤드리스 브라우저(임시 프로필)로 한 번 열어 그려진 화면의 글자와 구조, 구역의 위치를 읽음 (응답 200, 글자 4149자). 누르기와 입력 없음, 화면 캡처 없음
robots.txt. 따른 규칙: Allow /, Disallow 없음
흐름 읽기 기록. 누른 것 없음. 폼, 로그인, 가입, 결제, 구매 단추는 누르지 않음. 페이지가 요청을 보내려던 호스트 이름 3개 (본문, 쿠키, 토큰은 남기지 않음)
Published price guidance, per-project quote, scope, delivery and timelines.
Commercial clients, production and delivery described by studio.

Film production service, quoted scope and typical timeline.
Six-step project brief. No form submission.

customer.text: Official site describes target clients as brands, agencies, artists and technology companies. Portfolio is the studio own claim, not independently audited customer proof.

problem.text: Studio offers creative and AI video production from concept and script to delivery, plausibly addressing demand for professional promotional video without organizing a conventional shoot. Customer pain is not measured.

price.text: Official site: projects start at USD 15,000; commercials usually USD 50,000-125,000; individual quotes depend on length, scope and deliverables. These are advertised price guidance, not actual closed deals.
Home brief has selectable budget bands USD 15k-50k, 50k-100k, 100k-300k, 300k+ and uncertain. These are form choices, not completed contract values.

steps.label: 포트폴리오 발견
steps.text: Public landing page shows a showreel, film/commercial/music/viral work, selected clients and Start a Project. Actual acquisition channels are not verified.

steps.label: 제작 역량 검토
steps.text: A potential client may assess the showreel and selected projects before inquiring; actual visitor behavior is unmeasured.

steps.label: 뉴스레터 구독 (계정 아님)
steps.text: The Subscribe section Sign Up asks for email news/updates. Privacy says it goes to Mailchimp. Project brief explicitly says No account, no mailing list, and is separate. No account creation was verified.

steps.label: 제작 의뢰와 개별 견적
steps.text: The six-step project brief asks service type, budget, subject, details, name/company and email. Public pricing page promises a custom quote; no checkout or private contract was observed.

steps.label: 뉴스레터·후속 작품
steps.text: Newsletter and portfolio/social links may encourage return visits; retention and repeat customer data are unknown.

items.text: REA passive inspection reported rendered HTML, script resources and Cloudflare response header; the passive flow observed external host names without payload (E3). Backend code is not authenticated.
Privacy Policy states brief is emailed to the studio via Cloudflare, Google Workspace hosts mailbox, and newsletter list is held by Mailchimp; self-reported implementation.
Studio describes multiple AI video models plus its own workflows and normal editing, sound and color post-production.
Private server source, database, prompts, actual production costs and model configuration were not inspected.
